description:
Scheduler::reads, output_keys and dependency_uses (src/compiler2/scheduler.rs:494-519) each build an owned union across every answer a job owns. Consumers filter or probe it once: drive.rs concluded_answers_missing (reads + waits, once per pop_runnable), drive.rs:64 apply_completion (dependency_uses, to pull Product addresses), drive.rs:1110-1115 output_keys(&job).contains(..). Other callers: world.rs:626, :783, :789, telemetry/jsonl.rs:1344. Shape: iterate the derivations' read sets by reference; a claims(job, &F) -> bool that walks derivations x outputs. Builds on the borrowed DependencyIndex accessors. Also unforced in scheduler.rs: :701 concluded.output_keys.clone() and :737-741 previously_owned cloned, both dead after the line, so a move does it. Out of scope: the sorted Vec

snapshots in deps.rs subscribers / waiters / readers_of. Heat: per job pop and per completed job. Method: .agent/strategies/ownership-shape.md. Change the signature and let cargo check enumerate dependents; resolve interleavings by compute-then-commit or a split borrow; stop and report if an Rc is the only move. Signal: pure refactor. Full gate green; no golden, census or pin moves. Report the clone/to_vec count of each touched file before and after. Sites were read at develop 8bf8775ae and not compiled; confirm each with cargo check before relying on it.
title: Scheduler read accessors answer without building a set
